select s.student_no as xh, s.student_name as xm, case s.gender when '0' then '1' when '1' then '2' else '9' end as xbdm, date_format(s.birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as csrq, s.id_card as gmsfhm, d.dept_name as szyx, m.major_name as zymc, c.class_name as bjmc, regexp_replace(ifnull(s.enrollment_year, ''), '[^0-9]', '') as rxnj, case when s.education_level like '%博士%' then '10' when s.education_level like '%硕士%' then '20' when s.education_level like '%本科%' then '30' else '90' end as xlccdm, case s.student_status when '0' then '01' when '1' then '03' when '2' then '05' when '3' then '09' when '4' then '10' when '5' then '02' else '01' end as xjztdm, 4 as zxnx from sam_student s left join brm_department d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id left join brm_major m on s.major_id = m.major_id left join brm_class c on s.class_id = c.class_id
and s.status = '0' and s.dept_id = #{deptId}
and ( (s.student_status in ('0', '1', '5') and regexp_replace(ifnull(s.enrollment_year, ''), '[^0-9]', '') <= #{reportYear}) or (s.student_status = '3' and cast(nullif(regexp_replace(ifnull(s.enrollment_year, ''), '[^0-9]', ''), '') as unsigned) + 4 = cast(#{reportYear} as unsigned)) )
order by s.student_no asc

select s.student_no as xh, s.student_name as xm, cl.course_code as kch, cl.course_name as kcm, cast(cl.credit as char) as xf, cast(g.total_score as char) as cj, cast(g.grade_point as char) as jd, g.grade_level as cjdj, case when g.is_pass = '1' then 'Y' else 'N' end as jgdm, case g.exam_type when '0' then '1' when '1' then '2' when '2' then '3' else '1' end as kclx, sm.semester_name as xqmc, d.dept_name as szyx from aem_grade_record g left join sam_student s on g.student_id = s.student_id left join tpm_course_library cl on g.course_id = cl.course_id left join brm_semester sm on g.semester_id = sm.semester_id left join brm_academic_year ay on sm.academic_year_id = ay.year_id left join brm_department d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id
and g.status = '0' and s.dept_id = #{deptId}
and (ay.year_name = #{reportYear} or sm.semester_name like concat(#{reportYear}, '%'))
order by s.student_no asc, cl.course_code asc
select dept_name from brm_department where dept_id = #{deptId}
select dept_id as deptId, dept_name as deptName from brm_department where ifnull(status, '0') = '0' order by dept_id asc
